title: Shared market freezer allocation
passage:
Document 1 | Greenrush Market vendor handbook, freezer bays
A vendor books bays in the shared freezer, not spaces on a display table. A bay is large enough for one sealed box. Staff will not open boxes or split one box between bays. Each vendor pays for the number of bays on the posted list, even if they arrive with fewer boxes.
Before the posted list is printed on Wednesday, a vendor can give one reserved bay to another vendor. The receiving vendor must confirm the transfer, after which staff remove one bay from the sender's bill and add one to the receiver's. The bay price is the same for everyone. No bay transfer is available after printing. Vendors can still change the box contents, provided every box remains sealed and has its contents listed on the outside.
Document 2 | Tuesday email from Min, fruit-ice vendor
I booked three bays. I will bring just one box, and it already has a complete label. Nessa from the dumpling table needs one more bay. Could we transfer one of the spare bays to her? Neither of us needs to move our display tables. Please tell me what she needs to do; I don't want any unconfirmed change to my bill.
Document 3 | Wednesday message from the market desk, before printing
Nessa replied this morning that she accepts the bay. The revised fees are now on both accounts. A different vendor asked about adding a bay later; please direct them to the desk to ask about any remaining capacity, rather than offering a second bay of your own.
passageZh:
文件一｜Greenrush 市集攤商手冊：冷凍櫃格位
攤商預約的是共用冷凍櫃的格位，不是展示桌的空間。每格可放一個封妥的箱子。工作人員不會打開箱子，也不會把一箱物品分拆到不同格。就算實際帶來的箱子較少，仍依公告清單上的格位數收費。
週三清單印出前，攤商可以把一格已預約的格位轉給另一攤。受讓攤商必須確認；確認後，工作人員會從原攤商帳單減一格，並在受讓攤商帳單加一格。每格對各攤收費相同。清單印出後不可再轉讓格位。攤商仍可更換箱內物品，前提是箱子維持封妥，箱外列出內容物。
文件二｜水果冰品攤商 Min 週二寄出的電郵
我預約了三格。當天只會帶一箱，標籤已填妥。水餃攤的 Nessa 還需要一格。我們可以把其中一個空出的格位轉給她嗎？我們都不需要移動展示桌。請告訴我她需要怎麼做，我不希望帳單在未經確認就變動。
文件三｜市集服務台週三印清單前的訊息
Nessa 今天早上回覆接受該格位。兩個帳戶都已顯示更新後的費用。另有一位攤商詢問能否稍晚再加一格，請引導對方到服務台詢問是否有剩餘空間，而不要再從你自己的格位轉出第二格。
